name: The Parisian Macao
detail: One of the best hotel in Macau. I booked family room for 2 adult + 2 kids. Its great. I love the pool, we can take nice pictures there. And also if you guest of this hotel, you can go free to Eiffel tower , just show your hotel key. Breakfast is ok, i have to pay HKD 120 per kids.

name: Londoner Grand, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Macao
detail: Sheraton Macau was a surprise to me. I am the type who reads hotel reviews first before I book. I chose the Club King with Lounge access because buffet breakfast is included (just being practical). Fortunately, it also comes with an afternoon snacks and evening cocktail which for me is a big big plus. When we entered the lounge, we were greeted and attended to immediately by one of the hotel staffs (great job Alfie Rocamora). Staff like him is an asset to the company, very efficient so our check in was fast. Everything was explained, he knows what the guests need to know. We were able to check in at 130pm and was allowed to check out 1pm the following day (i have never experienced this with other 5 star hotels in Macau...only with Sheraton). We were also upgraded to a Cotai View room (what more can you ask for?). The bed was very comfortable and the bathroom was really nice. Outdoor pools are beautiful but the weather wasn't good at that time. Temperature was still cold (19degrees) so we were not really able to enjoy, we just took pictures of the surroundings. I highly recommend this for the quality of the hotel and staff performance as well as the value for money. Overall, it was an excellent stay!

name: Conrad Macao
detail: excellent excellent service and facilities shuttle buses available to all major attractions and hotels in macau. We spent new years eve at the Conrad and our room had the most spectacular view of the New Years Eve countdown from across the Venetian. Room was big and very nice. With Ipad docks and Nespresso machines. We even have complimentary candies and stuffed toy upon check in Good reasonably priced restaurants in the casino floor as well. Nice quiet lobby relative to other more crowded Macau hotels

name: Hotel Royal Macau
detail: Convenience place to stay in Macau & there are few vegetarian shops nearby within walking distance. I found 3 vegetarian shops which are less than 5 mins walking to their shop. Hotel provides shuttle bus to ferry station & you can actually take other interchange shuttle buses provided by other Casino Hotels to around Macau. Hotel has indoor swimming pool & a little casino as well. Price is very reasonable when you compared to other 5 star hotel in Macau. Public transport is 6 MOP /pax per trip no matter the distance (1st or last stop). Thanks Roy for the free upgrade to Deluxe room. Will come back again.

name: Inn Hotel Macau
detail: My family went to macau to celebrate my birthday, we requested for something that hotel operators dont normally allow. I guess they see a compromise since we arrived and occupied the room late at night. I appreciated that the Hotel Manager Vera Wang making a compromise, we didnt get exactly what we are asking for like a super late check out but she giftef me an extended two hours after the check out time as a gift for my birthday; to a family that goea on DIY travel Itinerary, the gift is a big help knowing that our flight back home is late at night. As far as facilities is perfect 5 star; rooms in tip top shape, smells good, such a cozy place to stay after a long explorative day. Service is a perfect 5 star; from free bus to one spot to another to a free mobile phone to help DIY travelers to navigate through the day's agenda. Where in the earth does a Hotel offers free mobile use, in the tech age nowadays. This s just a cool and smart addition to the package. The free breakfast package is perfect 5 star, all american breakfast buffet. Such a great way to start your day. Shout out to Security Staff Jack or Jax, one of the hotel's asset. He assisted me to grab a taxi in the middle of rain at one point, has offered concierge service from the hotel lobby to the bus. Overall, Inn Hotel Macau is the hotel for my family. DIY travelers, backpackers, and people who wants to get the most of what of their trips. Inn Hotel Macau is the choice and the only option you'all had to take.

name: Golden Crown China Hotel
detail: Best value for money as most hotels in Macau are high end and budget hotels are mostly far from the airport. But this hotel's location is really good considering that it's right in front of the airport and very near the ferry terminal. We can cross the road and take advantage of the free shuttles. They have an area where you can leave your luggages so you can go around before your flight. Breakfast is included though it could have been a better (the only downside). Staff was nice and speaks good English.

name: Grandview Hotel
detail: This is my third stay in this hotel and going to make it my regular hotel in Macau. We were upgraded and got rooms facing the race course, hills and sea. The rooms are great, big and clean with comfortable beds. The Chinese restaurant on the 2nd floor serves good food and reasonably priced too. The restaurant staff are probably the most polite people we met in Macau. There are supermarkets and local eateries behind the block. Buses and taxis can be found beside the hotel for easy transportation.

name: Hotel Golden Dragon
detail: The room as big and spacious and the bed was comfy as well.

name: Grand Dragon Hotel
detail: It is always a pleasure to stay in the Hotel Taipa Square. Offering, arguably, the best value accomodation in Macau and Taipa it is minutes from the best new Casinos, the Venetian and World of Dreams and stands immediately infront of the Macau Jockey club and probably its best international bar, the Sports Bar. The rooms are good sized, clean and comfortable. It could do better with in-room drink making (no milk or sugar) and the breakfast which is a wonderful buffet should be inclusive to encourage use. I will go there again.

name: Rio Hotel Macau
detail: Decent hotel with relatively big rooms (when compared to HK), even though mine was a standard/basic room. Casino downstairs with pretty low minimum stakes which is good for the novice. Minimum stakes: Room service was fast and good. No ridiculously high deposit required for incidentals. Just for 2 nights (and I assume it'll be the same for more nights) - there are many hotels in Macau whichT. It's fully refundable Poor shuttle service (it's like once every hour to the ferry terminal only) but you can take a cab to the ferry terminal where you can hop on to other free buses to other resorts like The Venetian, Galaxy, etc. It's walking distance to Star World, Wynn, Lisboa, etc. that are on the main Macau peninsular. Free breakfast included with many room rates including my cheap one. Very average food but it's buffet style. Better than nothing I guess. Free welcome drink too, at a bar with literally has 3 tables and zero customers but whatever. One free drink (bottled beer, juice, coffee/tea) without any minimum spend. Decent satellite channels and local (HK, Macau, and CCTV ones). If it's at around on a non-Saturday, it's worth it. Free Wi-Fi internet that doesn't seem to limit the number of devices per room.
